learningObjective: Trace cached values forward and upstream gradients backward through local derivatives without constructing a full Jacobian.
mediumRationale: A deterministic SVG can place two directions, exact scalar values, local derivative multipliers, and gradient results on one computation graph. Mermaid lacks the label control needed for this trace.

pages.insight: The gradient slide establishes local slope and update direction before the algorithm is introduced.
The deck uses a computational graph to break a complex expression into local operations and pass gradients backward.

deckReview.notes: The deck's computation-graph framing is the correct spatial model. The site redraw uses an original scalar example so every value and derivative can be checked directly.

agentReview.summary: Recommended a deterministic SVG with forward values above the graph and reverse adjoints below it. The implementation uses a five-node scalar example and explicit local multipliers.

implementation.accessibility: The SVG includes a title and complete description. Solid and dashed paths distinguish direction, every result is labeled, and the caption states the VJP inference.
